name: How long does a whole house interior renovation typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a whole house interior renovation typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a whole house interior renovation varies significantly based on the project's complexity and scope. A cosmetic update might take 2-4 months, while a major renovation involving structural changes or reconfiguring layouts could take 6-12 months or more. Factors like material lead times, permit acquisition, and unforeseen conditions can also impact the timeline. We provide a detailed project schedule before starting.
acceptedAnswer.description: The duration varies from 2 months for cosmetic updates to 6-12 months for major renovations, depending on scope and complexity.
